transcript.answer: Yes. Issue #498 in re-cinq/Otto, "Stop the tool-budget message promising a follow-up while no escalation destination exists", is open. It is labelled type:bug, priority:medium, area:compliance and lore:blocked, and saadahmed95 opened it on 2026-10-23. TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA (from #151, shipped in #439) ends with "En kollega vil følge op på din henvendelse" ("a colleague will follow up"). When no escalation destination is configured, as in the re:cinq test environment, no one is notified, so the promise goes unmet. The FR-017 test doesn't catch this because it only forbids contact details and a persona name. The issue is blocked on two things: a decision on what the message may promise while no destination exists (KU-14), and a Danish speaker for any new wording (KU-15). The same question also blocks FR-013 and FR-014 of #460.

judgements.reason: The answer says yes, matching the gold answer, and adds supporting detail that does not contradict it.
